name: Calamitous Strike
description: The lands were forged through storm, frost, and flame, which all must be kept in harmony to avoid calamity.
effect: Devotees of the Keepers of the Elements may call upon 'Calamitous Strike' by spending a charge as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to change the typing of their move to Ice, Electric, or Fire, and applying a STAB bonus as if the move matched the User's typing. In addition, this move may become an All Foes Move. You have a number of Charges of this Move equal to your Rank. At Luminary, you can expend 2 Charges to roll your full offensive stat with the All Foes Move that you use this Boon with.
